label: From nanoseconds to cycles
subgoals: Look up the operator delay for the type and width
Divide by the usable clock period

label: Latency of a registered chain
subgoals: Convert each operation's delay to cycles
Sum the cycle counts along the chain
Compare cycles times period with the raw delay to see the quantization loss

label: Choosing the clock period
subgoals: Compute the cycle count of the chain at each candidate period
Multiply by the period to get total time
Weigh time against the extra registers of a faster clock
